title: When does the Pikkazo gate close?
body: Every soul freed is a Pikkazo bought off the old collection's floor. While the gate stays open, the market we escaped keeps out-trading the museum — our own fire feeds its volume. Pick the mark where the gate seals for good, and the market turns to face Cubist Souls alone.

options.label: Seal at 3,000 souls
options.sub: close early — turn the market to Souls sooner

options.label: Seal at 4,000 souls
options.sub: one more wave through the fire, then seal

options.label: Keep it open for now
options.sub: let it burn — revisit at a later salon

applies: the museum seals the Pikkazo→Soul gate at the winning mark; the sealing transaction goes in the ledger
